entries.e20776ec382fd63e: Following the transition to a holding company structure, the company formulated the group management guideline 'Story for Innovating the Future'. The management vision is to remain an 'indispensable company' that supports the promotion and development of industries in the future, redefining its 'founding spirit' to match changes in the times and society. It sets out a transformation into a 'New Business Contractor' that creates new businesses beyond the framework of the construction industry, and under the 'Medium-Term Management Plan (through fiscal 2027)' it will pursue expansion of its earnings base, management conscious of cost of capital, and strengthened governance.
